```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(viridis)
library(FactoMineR)
library(lubridate)
library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(MASS)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(car)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggsignif)
```


# 1. Open dataset
```{r}
dataset_500_ENI_Lea <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.2. Models/Raw/dataset_500_ENI_Lea.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X) 

summary(dataset_500_ENI_Lea$p_bio)
```


# 2. Scale & modif type of variables 
```{r}
predictors <- dataset_500_ENI_Lea %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as_factor(id_parcelle),
         annee=as_factor(annee),
         type_production=as_factor(type_production),
         RegionAgricole=as_factor(RegionAgricole),
      region_biogeo=as_factor(region_biogeo),
      TypeCulture=as_factor(TypeCulture),
         clust=as_factor(clust),
         code_parcelle=as_factor(code_parcelle),
         exposition2=as_factor(exposition2)) %>% 
  relocate(code_parcelle) %>% 
  mutate(entomogame_1=scale(entomogame_1),
         FRic_flow=scale(FRic_flow),
         FRic=scale(FRic),
         FDiv_flow=scale(FDiv_flow),
         FDiv=scale(FDiv),
         FEve_flow=scale(FEve_flow),
         FEve=scale(FEve),
         Flow_dur=scale(Flow_dur),
         Flow_on=scale(Flow_on),
         nectar_present_1=scale(nectar_present_1), 
         zygomorphe_1=scale(zygomorphe_1), 
        JulianDay=scale(JulianDay),
         RisqueDebordement=scale(RisqueDebordement),
         coord_x=scale(coord_x),
         coord_y=scale(coord_y),
         Bordure_Largeur=scale(Bordure_Largeur),
         Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage=scale(Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage),
         Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage=scale(Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage),
         Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR=scale(Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR),
         IFT_Herbicide2013_2019=scale(IFT_Herbicide2013_2019),
          IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019=scale(IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019),
                                         DivRotation=scale(DivRotation),
SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1=scale(SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1),
          IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019=scale(IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019),
          CoefN=scale(CoefN),
          IFT_H=scale(IFT_H),
          IFT_T=scale(IFT_T),
          p_bio=scale(p_bio),
          forbs_100 =scale(forbs_100),
          perennial_100=scale(perennial_100),
        neophytes_100=scale(neophytes_100), 
        messicole_100=scale(messicole_100),
        nat_val_100=scale(nat_val_100),
        weeds_100=scale(weeds_100),
          rich_sp=scale(rich_sp),  
          shannon=scale(shannon), 
          nb_hill=scale(nb_hill))
```

# A. % forbs

## Méditerranéen
```{r}
predictors_medi <- predictors %>% 
  filter(region_biogeo=="ZM"|region_biogeo=="C")
```


### 1. Temporalité et conditions parcellaires
```{r}
m0 <- lmer(forbs_100 ~ annee + JulianDay^2 + RisqueDebordement + coord_x + coord_y + exposition2 + TypeCulture+(1| code_parcelle)+ (1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_medi, REML=F,na.action="na.fail")
vif(m0)
dredge(m0)
m0_best <- lmer(forbs_100 ~ annee +JulianDay^2+(1| code_parcelle)+ (1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_medi, REML=T, na.action="na.fail")
summary(m0_best)
Anova(m0_best)
r.squaredGLMM(m0_best)
```
Fixed effects:
            Estimate Std. Error t value
(Intercept)  0.50853    0.22414   2.269
annee2014   -0.40550    0.13407  -3.025
annee2015   -0.33861    0.13980  -2.422
annee2016   -0.14653    0.13444  -1.090
annee2017   -0.47354    0.13474  -3.514
annee2018   -0.52471    0.13547  -3.873
JulianDay   -0.26027    0.07605  -3.422

Response: forbs_100
           Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)    
annee     22.904  5  0.0003521 ***
JulianDay 11.712  1  0.0006210 ***

            R2m       R2c
[1,] 0.08639829 0.5091304

### 2. Type de production 

```{r}
mod_bio <- lmer(forbs_100 ~  annee +JulianDay^2  + type_production+(1| code_parcelle)+(1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_medi, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
vif(mod_bio)
dredge(mod_bio)
```
ns

### 3. Pratiques
#### 3.1. Pesticides échelle paysages
```{r}
mod_pest <- lmer(forbs_100 ~  annee +JulianDay^2 + IFT_H+ IFT_T+p_bio+ (1| code_parcelle)+(1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_medi, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
dredge(mod_pest)
mod_pest_best <- lmer(forbs_100~annee +JulianDay^2 + IFT_T+p_bio+ (1| code_parcelle) , data=predictors_medi, REML=T, na.action="na.fail")
summary(mod_pest_best)
Anova(mod_pest_best)
r.squaredGLMM(mod_pest_best)
```
Fixed effects:
            Estimate Std. Error t value

#### 3.2. Pratiques de gestion de la bordure
```{r}
mod_bord <- lmer(forbs_100 ~annee +JulianDay^2 + IFT_T+p_bio+  Bordure_Largeur+Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage+ Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage+Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR+ (1| code_parcelle)+(1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_medi, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
vif(mod_bord)
dredge(mod_bord)
```
ns

```{r}

vif(mod_prat)
dredge(mod_prat)
mod_prat_best <- lmer(forbs_100 ~ annee +JulianDay^2 + IFT_T+p_bio +IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019+SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1+(1| code_parcelle)+(1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_medi, REML=T, na.action="na.fail")
summary(mod_prat_best)
```

```{r}
dredge(m0)

summary(m0_best)
Anova(m0_best)
r.squaredGLMM(m0_best)
```

```{r}
mod_prat <- lmer(weeds_100 ~  JulianDay^2 + coord_y+ IFT_H+ IFT_T+ Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage+ IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019 +IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019 +IFT_Herbicide2013_2019+DivRotation+CoefN+SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1+ (1| code_parcelle) + (1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_temp, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
vif(mod_prat)
dredge(mod_prat)
mod_prat_best <- lmer(weeds_100 ~ JulianDay^2 + coord_y+ IFT_H+ Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage + CoefN +IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019+IFT_Herbicide2013_2019 +(1| code_parcelle) + (1| region_biogeo), data=predictors_temp, REML=T, na.action="na.fail")
summary(mod_prat_best)
Anova(mod_prat_best)
r.squaredGLMM(mod_prat_best)
```
